objective: LIMIT-ONLY-20261112-001 direction 2 (G17, with G7), at the owner's go-ahead of 2026-11-12 ('iterate on it for a bit') and the coordinator's steer: on the nested NAE families that die at every finite depth from T on while the usual limit lives, ask first whether the limit lives only because everything comes loose, then whether the all-equal ends that every living state needs at each dead depth can sit on a single call per depth, and on a single ray of calls each inside the one before. Standalone value relative to the nearest known work: compactness, fixed points and tree-structured satisfiability are known; the arrangement of the forced all-equal state in limit-only NAE patterns was not found.
status: Complete 2026-11-12 (Partially successful; referee pending): in genuine limit-only nested NAE families every living state must spread the all-equal ends over two or more calls at some dead depth (797 of 800 branching families); a single ray almost never works; 87% are loose at the bottom only. Recommendation: Research directions, how the all-equal state spreads.
